scanNote:
15-BET. Unit 2 davomi — 'can' grammatikasi va qobiliyatlar.

Ikkala rasmli mashq ham skaner bilan tekshirildi, HAMMASI TO'G'RI:

12a — rasmda 8 ta narsa bor: car, bus, dog, helicopter, train, motorbike, plane, cat.
  Ro'yxatda esa 11 ta so'z: qo'shimcha guitar, piano, computer — bularning rasmi YO'Q.
  ⚠ Bu — kitobning ataylab qo'ygan tuzog'i: uchtasiga 'No, I can't' deb javob beriladi. Izohda tushuntirilgan.

13 — 8 ta surat:
  1 swim fast (basseyndagi suzuvchi), 2 type fast (kompyuterda yozayotgan ayol), 3 walk fast (paltoda tez yurayotgan erkak), 4 speak English well ('HELLO!' pufakchasi), 5 dance well (baletchi qiz), 6 read fast (kitob o'qiyotgan bola), 7 cook well (likopchali oshpaz), 8 run fast (yugurayotgan ayol).

  Ro'yxat harflari bilan: a=7, b=5, c=4, d=8, e=3, f=6, g=1, h=2.

⚠ Foizli shkala kitobda bosilgan: very well/fast 95%, quite well/fast 70%, not very well/fast 40%, no 0%. Izohda saqlangan.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the pictures from the Photo File section and write descriptions of the people. Write about their age, hair, eyes, height and build.
exercises.instructionUz: Photo File bo'limidagi rasmlardan foydalanib odamlarning tavsifini yozing. Yosh, soch, ko'z, bo'y va gavda haqida yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
Tavsif qolipi — 5 ta nuqta, shu tartibda:
  1) AGE    — He is twenty years old. / He is young.
  2) HAIR   — He has got short dark hair.
  3) EYES   — He has got brown eyes.
  4) HEIGHT — He is quite tall.
  5) BUILD  — He is slim.

Soch va ko'z uchun HAVE GOT, yosh/bo'y/gavda uchun BE ishlatiladi.
Sochni bir gapda birlashtirsa bo'ladi: 'He has got short dark hair and brown eyes.'

structure.modelEn: This is Tom. He is twenty-five years old. He has got short curly brown hair and green eyes. He is tall and well-built.
This is Sally. She is middle-aged. She has got long straight fair hair and blue eyes. She is quite short and slim.

rule.explanationUz:
'can' — modal fe'l. Uning ikkita katta afzalligi bor:

1) BARCHA SHAXSLARDA BIR XIL. He/she/it bilan ham -S QO'SHILMAYDI:
     I can · he can · they can   ('he cans' — XATO)

2) O'zidan keyingi fe'l ASOS SHAKLIDA turadi:
     'He can play' — 'to play' ham, 'plays' ham EMAS.

Ikki ma'noda ishlatiladi:
  • QOBILIYAT — Tom can play football. (Tom futbol o'ynay oladi)
  • ILTIMOS  — Can you help me, please? (Menga yordam bera olasizmi?)
rule.negativeNoteUz: To'liq shakl BITTA so'z bo'lib yoziladi: 'cannot' ('can not' emas). Qisqasi — can't.
rule.interrogativeNoteUz:
So'roqda 'do/does' ISHLATILMAYDI: 'Can you swim?' — 'Do you can swim?' XATO.
Qisqa javobda asosiy fe'l TAKRORLANMAYDI: 'Yes, I can.' ('Yes, I can swim' emas).
rule.exampleEn: Tom can play football. (ability) / Can you help me, please? (polite request)
rule.exampleUz: Tom futbol o'ynay oladi. (qobiliyat) / Menga yordam bera olasizmi? (iltimos)
rule.warningUz:
ENG KO'P XATO: 'can' dan keyin 'to' qo'yish.
  'I can swim'  — TO'G'RI
  'I can to swim' — XATO

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures and the list of words below. Ask and answer questions, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarga va quyidagi so'zlar ro'yxatiga qarang. Namunadagidek savol-javob qiling.
exercises.explanationUz:
Qolip: 'Can you see a ...?' → 'Yes, I can.' / 'No, I can't.'

DIQQAT: 'see' — ko'rmoq. Bu yerda 'can' qobiliyat emas, IMKONIYAT
ma'nosida: rasmda bormi-yo'qmi.

Ro'yxatda 11 ta so'z bor, lekin rasmda faqat 8 tasi. Uchtasi YO'Q —
o'sha uchtasiga 'No, I can't' deb javob beriladi.

exercises.audioRequiredUz: Tovushlar audio'da beriladi. Audio bo'lmasa ham qolip va namuna gaplar to'liq o'rganiladi.
exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures in Ex. 12 again and listen to the sounds. First tick, then say what you can or can't hear.
exercises.instructionUz: Ex. 12 rasmlariga qayta qarang va tovushlarni eshiting. Avval belgilang, so'ng nimani eshitib, nimani eshitmayotganingizni ayting.
exercises.explanationUz:
Qolip: 'I can hear a ..., but I can't hear a ...'

'but' — qarama-qarshilik bog'lovchisi. Ikki gapni bitta gapga birlashtiradi:
  I can hear a cat. + I can't hear a motorbike.
  → I can hear a cat, BUT I can't hear a motorbike.

'but' oldidan VERGUL qo'yiladi.

sentences.en: I can hear a cat, but I can't hear a motorbike.
sentences.uz: Men mushukni eshityapman, lekin mototsiklni eshitmayapman.

sentences.en: I can hear a dog, but I can't hear a train.
sentences.uz: Men itni eshityapman, lekin poyezdni eshitmayapman.

sentences.en: I can hear a plane, but I can't hear a bus.
sentences.uz: Men samolyotni eshityapman, lekin avtobusni eshitmayapman.

sentences.en: I can hear a car, but I can't hear a helicopter.
sentences.uz: Men mashinani eshityapman, lekin vertolyotni eshitmayapman.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the phrases in the list to the pictures. Then, in pairs, ask and answer questions to find out what your partner can or can't do, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdagi iboralarni rasmlarga moslang. So'ng juftlikda sherigingiz nima qila olishi va qila olmasligini savol-javob bilan aniqlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
QANCHALIK YAXSHI — daraja aytish shkalasi:
  very well / very fast   — 95%  (juda yaxshi / juda tez)
  quite well / quite fast — 70%  (ancha yaxshi / ancha tez)
  not very well / not very fast — 40%  (unchalik emas)
  no                      — 0%   (umuman yo'q)

DIQQAT — 'well' va 'fast' farqi:
  • well  — SIFAT darajasi: cook well, dance well, speak English well
  • fast  — TEZLIK: run fast, walk fast, read fast, swim fast, type fast

'well' — 'good' ning ravish shakli. 'I cook good' XATO, 'I cook well' to'g'ri.

answers.descEn: A woman typing at a computer
A man in a coat walking quickly
A woman with a "HELLO!" speech bubble
A chef with a plate of food
A woman jogging on a road

example.speaker: S2
example.en: Yes. I can cook quite well. Can you dance?
example.uz: Ha. Ancha yaxshi pishiraman. Siz raqsga tusha olasizmi?

example.speaker: S3
example.en: No, I can't. Can you dance?

scale.en: not very well / not very fast
scale.uz: unchalik yaxshi emas / unchalik tez emas

wordFormation.introUz: Ravish yasalishi — 'qanday?' savoliga javob beruvchi so'zlar.

groups.explanationUz:
Sifat NARSANI ta'riflaydi, ravish esa HARAKATNI.
Ko'pchilik ravish -ly bilan yasaladi.

groups.ruleUz: QOIDASIZ ravishlar — bu betda aynan shular
groups.explanationUz: Ikkita eng muhim ravish -ly OLMAYDI. Ular shakli o'zgarmaydi yoki butunlay boshqa so'z bo'ladi.

sentencePatterns.introUz: 'can' ning barcha shakllari — Unit 2 ning ikkinchi asosiy grammatikasi.

patterns.exampleEn: Tom can play football. / They can swim.
patterns.exampleUz: Tom futbol o'ynay oladi. / Ular suza oladi.
patterns.explanationUz:
'can' barcha shaxsda bir xil — -S yo'q, 'to' yo'q.
'He can plays' va 'He can to play' — ikkalasi ham XATO.
To'liq shakli 'cannot' — BITTA so'z bo'lib yoziladi.

patterns.formula: SO'ROQ: Can + EGA + FE'L? → Yes, EGA can. / No, EGA can't.
patterns.exampleEn: Can you cook? — Yes, I can. / No, I can't.
patterns.explanationUz: 'do/does' ishlatilmaydi. Qisqa javobda asosiy fe'l takrorlanmaydi.

patterns.formula: DARAJA: EGA + can + FE'L + very/quite + well/fast
patterns.exampleEn: I can cook quite well. / She can swim very fast.
patterns.exampleUz: Men ancha yaxshi ovqat pishiraman. / U juda tez suzadi.
patterns.explanationUz: Daraja so'zi fe'ldan KEYIN keladi. 'well' sifat uchun, 'fast' tezlik uchun.

patterns.exampleEn: I can hear a cat, but I can't hear a motorbike.
patterns.exampleUz: Men mushukni eshityapman, lekin mototsiklni eshitmayapman.
patterns.explanationUz: 'but' oldidan vergul qo'yiladi. Ikki qarama-qarshi gapni birlashtiradi.
Bu yerda 'can' qobiliyat emas — muloyim ILTIMOS. 'please' oxirida, vergul bilan.
